summary: The session showcased how AI agents integrated into a data fabric can transform healthcare by improving clinician workflows and patient interactions. A demonstration highlighted the use of AI to streamline documentation and enhance decision-making during doctor-patient conversations. Key design considerations included ensuring data quality, governance, and the importance of keeping humans in the loop.

key_points: AI can relieve clinician burnout by automating documentation.
Generative AI projects often fail to deliver expected ROI.
AI supports clinicians by summarizing patient histories.
The solution captures and organizes patient interactions seamlessly.
AI agents require comprehensive data context to make accurate decisions.
Governance and ethical use of data are critical in healthcare.
A data fabric enables integration of structured and unstructured data.
Real-time feedback loops ensure human oversight in AI decision-making.

key_takeaways: AI can significantly reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers.
Integrating AI into clinical workflows enhances patient care and decision-making.
Maintaining data quality and governance is essential for successful AI implementations.
